summary: Preserve parallel Kimi draft projections and independent target and draft cache geometry
details: Supports DSpark and DFlash projection staging, compact rotary tables and draft-specific cache policies.
Retains explicit Markov-head quantization while permitting TP sharding. Target DCP partitions do not change replicated draft-cache addressing.
Validates noncausal decode and DCP replication when merging MLA cache specifications.
